title: Invalid: overlapping fragment descriptors (obsolete)
description: SAR archive where two fragment descriptors have overlapping byte ranges. Must fail with an invalid map error regardless of LOSS_TOLERANT.
notes: DEFERRED: LOSS_TOLERANT must not suppress overlap errors.

OBSOLETE (M13b WP-3): canonical LFH has no absolute-offset descriptor, so fragment overlap is unrepresentable. Retained as a deferred placeholder; the canonical duplicate-Fragment-Index case is covered by duplicate-index. Reassigned to WP-4 for removal or replacement.
